headline: Sensex rallies 685 points as Nifty crosses 22,750; Pharma and Oil & Gas sectors lead market gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex surged 685 points, closing significantly higher at 22,776.
Outperformance in the Pharma and Oil & Gas sectors boosted investor sentiment.
The market continued its relief rally, snapping a previous record losing streak.
Union Cabinet's approval of a ₹10,000-crore SME growth fund supported the manufacturing outlook.
whatHappening: The GST Council is scheduled to meet on October 8 to discuss a five-pronged reform plan.
Mphasis has extended its international partnership with Social Security Scotland for their benefits platform.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted how next-gen GST reforms will power India's economic journey.
Markets remain watchful of global cues and FII selling patterns despite the significant two-day recovery.
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a strong rally on October 6, with the Sensex gaining 685 points and Nifty ending above 22,750. Gains were primarily driven by the Pharma and Oil & Gas sectors, alongside positive news regarding SME funding and upcoming GST reforms. Mphasis and Reliance Industries were among the specific stocks in focus during the session.
